name: Input OTP
description: Boxes for a one-time code, drawn over one real input so typing, pasting and autofill all work.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the code, cleaned of spaces and dashes, as it changes.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once every box is filled.

props.name: groups
props.description: Box counts between separators, for example [3, 3].

props.name: mask
props.description: Show dots instead of the characters.

props.name: inputMode
props.description: Digits only, or letters and digits. Also picks the on-screen keyboard.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Camellia borders and the error message; the boxes give a small shake as it turns on.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the input and dims the boxes.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the boxes. Without one, give it an aria-label.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the boxes. Replaced by the error while invalid.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the boxes while invalid.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the input for form submission.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of a div.
